name: Load Models
description: A diffusion model with its text encoder and VAE, picked from your model folders, as one model for Text Encode, Sampler and VAE Encode.

inputs.name: text_encoder
inputs.label: Text encoder
inputs.description: The language model the diffusion model reads prompts with: Qwen3 4B for Z-Image Turbo and FLUX.2 Klein 4B, Qwen3 8B for Klein 9B; UMT5 for Wan; T5 (t5xxl) for FLUX.1.

inputs.name: clip_l
inputs.label: CLIP-L
inputs.description: FLUX.1 (Dev, Fill, Kontext) reads a CLIP-L encoder beside its T5, which goes in Text encoder. Leave empty for the other models.

inputs.name: tokenizer
inputs.label: Tokenizer
inputs.description: MOSS Image reads the official Qwen3.5 tokenizer.json, which no model file holds. Leave empty to use qwen3.5_tokenizer.json from your tokenizers folder (the list offers its download); the other models take none.

inputs.name: high_noise_diffusion_model
inputs.label: High-noise diffusion model
inputs.description: Wan 2.2 14B makes a clip with two diffusion models: this one for the first, noisiest steps, and the Diffusion model for the rest.
